config_name: XPS 16 Creator Edition — NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X (20-core) + Blackwell RTX 6144-core GPU, 32GB, 1TB, 16" 3.2K OLED touch

specs.cpu: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X (20-core Arm CPU, up to 4.0 GHz)
specs.ports: 3x USB4 Type-C (DP 2.1, PD), HDMI 2.1b, headset jack

battery.notes: No verified CA runtime figure; RTX Spark N1X class estimated ~8-10h mixed use. Marked estimated per SCHEMA.

price.notes: VERIFIED dell.ca 2026-11-24: CAD $4,799.99 (est. value $5,599.99, $800 instant redemption).

reviews.quote: No professional review of this exact RTX Spark XPS 16 SKU as of 2026-11; ratings inferred from the CNET XPS 16 (2026) chassis anchor and RTX Spark platform coverage.

praises: First XPS with real RTX graphics: Blackwell 6144-core GPU crushes the Arc-iGPU XPS 16 for 3D, gaming, and CUDA work
Full creator I/O returns: SDXC slot, HDMI 2.1b, 3x USB4 — no more dock tax (dell.ca spec sheet)
RTX Spark N1X 20-core CPU + unified memory is the strongest local-AI stack Dell sells
3.2K OLED touch with 1000-nit peak is the brightest panel in the XPS range
$800 Black Friday redemption narrows the gap to the iGPU XPS 16
complaints: Arm Windows app-translation caveats still apply to the RTX Spark platform (some anti-cheat and pro plugins)
Heavier and thicker than the standard XPS 16 (17.8 mm, ~2.1 kg) — 'creator' costs you portability
No independent pro review of this exact SKU yet; platform reviews are mixed on battery ('disappointing' per IT Pro on the RTX Spark platform)
$4,800 entry price; 64GB tier jumps to $5,800 and 128GB/2TB to $8,900
Windows on Arm gaming compatibility varies despite the strong GPU hardware

design_philosophy: Dell's answer to the Apple-Max-class creator laptop: pair NVIDIA's Arm RTX Spark SoC with the XPS 16 chassis so creators get RTX-class GPU + CUDA in a thin Windows clamshell. It deliberately trades x86 compatibility for GPU and NPU muscle.
rating_notes: No direct pro review of DX16263 yet; ratings inferred from CNET XPS 16 (2026) 8.0 chassis anchor + RTX Spark platform press (IT Pro battery criticism). Arm Windows → ecosystem 7.5 per NOTES calibration; RTX 6144-core GPU → gaming 7.5, creative_work 8.5, ai_ml 9.0 (CUDA + unified memory); SD/HDMI/USB4 → port_connectivity 8.5; weight 2.1 kg → portability 7.0. Weight and battery estimated.
